parallel.requirements: Recognized the need to implement a Node.js ESM replacement for markdown/test13.py with CLI parity and markdown extension output parity.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used a two-stage swarm: first read-only behavior probes, then module-specific implementation owners for text, inline, code, toc, extras, blocks, and CLI.
parallel.implementation: Completed text.mjs, code.mjs, toc.mjs, and cli.mjs; wrote inline.mjs but left known failures; extras.mjs and blocks.mjs never reached a write.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Did not create the required test13.mjs entry and did not assemble partial modules into a runnable final solution.
parallel.verification: Some child-level checks and executable probes ran, but there was no integrated end-to-end verification after assembly because assembly never occurred.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Three implementation children were aborted, core modules were missing, inline behavior was still incorrect, and artifact validation failed for missing test13.mjs.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Python-to-JavaScript markdown conversion and CLI parity requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept the work in the main serial trajectory, repeatedly probing the executable and planning an implementation without delegation.
serial.implementation: Performed extensive behavior probes but did not write any implementation files before cancellation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No modules or entry point were delivered; the artifact directory was empty at validation.
serial.verification: Used the executable for exploratory behavior checks, but never verified a JS implementation or assembled solution.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The entire deliverable remained unwritten, including the required test13.mjs entry file.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had the same prompt requirements: ESM files in /output, manual CLI parsing, and Python-Markdown behavior across extra, tables, codehilite, fenced_code, and toc.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt requirements and spent its single-threaded attempt probing the executable behavior for those markdown and CLI obligations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is shown; the difference is how the attempts pursued and delivered the same requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split the task into probe children and then module owners for text, inline, code, toc, extras, blocks, and CLI.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in one main trajectory and performed local executable probes without spawning subagents or separate implementation owners.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created a broad child-owned module plan; serial stayed local and sequential, so its failure mode was no artifact rather than partial child-owned modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel briefs described module files and expected exports, and completed children returned summaries for several modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated executable observations in one context and did not need cross-agent handoff or module interface transfer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The interface risk was parallel-specific, but no retained context label applies because the observed adverse event was cancellation before unfinished modules could hand off results.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote partial library modules including text, inline, code, toc, and CLI, with inline still showing known harness failures.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial probed many markdown behaviors but produced no files in the artifact directory before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel made partial implementation progress but no entry point; serial made no deliverable implementation progress at all.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel cancelled an active implementation swarm and received a result stating four children completed while three were aborted.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had only the main local trajectory and was cancelled at the end of its probing work, with no child lifecycle to join.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel result lifecycle lost active child work; the serial lifecycle ended as a single cancelled local attempt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact validation found only library files and no required test13.mjs entry, so the partial modules were never assembled into the deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation found an empty artifact directory and the same missing expected entry.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left an unassembled partial tree; serial left no tree to integrate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children ran component-level checks, but one inline harness still had seven failures and the parent never ran an integrated evaluator-aligned solution check.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran many executable probes but did not reach implementation or whole-solution verification before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had partial component verification with unresolved failures; serial had exploratory verification only, not deliverable verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after a high-fan-out run; the active implementation swarm was cancelled before remaining modules and final assembly finished.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out after a long single-threaded probing pass, with no writes captured in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed by timeout, but parallel spent the closure window across active children while serial spent it in one local investigation path.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both modes failed the current completed official evaluation with 0 of 149 samples passed. Parallel differed by producing partial library modules but omitting the required test13.mjs entry after cancelling active implementation children; serial differed by timing out during local probing and leaving an empty artifact directory.
parallel_contributors: Implementation swarm was explicitly cancelled with three child workers aborted.
Artifact validation found partial library files but no required test13.mjs entry.
serial_contributors: Serial remained in one local probing trajectory and was cancelled before writing files.
Artifact validation found no delivered files at all.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel inline.mjs still had known behavior mismatches from its local harness.
Serial did not progress far enough to expose ordinary implementation defects because no implementation was written.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; the evidence supports process and deliverable differences only, not a discordant-outcome cause

candidates.reason: Parallel assigned implementation owners for text, inline, code, toc, extras, blocks, and CLI modules; the adverse event was later cancellation, not absence of an implementer.
The parent kept orchestration and planned integration rather than leaving component reconciliation ownerless; integration never happened because the swarm and parent were cancelled.
The missing test13.mjs entry was a realized delivery gap, but the parent/orchestration plan retained assembly responsibility and was interrupted before reaching it.
The end-to-end pipeline was under parent orchestration; the failure was interruption of active implementation work, not an unowned sequence across stages.
The parallel run did not block all productive work behind one mandatory serial preflight; it ran overlapping probe and implementation children.
Although probing preceded the implementation swarm, productive implementation children did start and write files; the retained problem is active child cancellation during implementation.
No separate indispensable path was starved while auxiliary work consumed capacity; the same unfinished path is explained by explicit cancellation of active implementation children.
The high fan-out and timeout are visible, but the directly evidenced boundary is the cancellation result with three aborted implementation children, so the budget symptom is not retained separately.
The unfinished extras and blocks children had broad scopes, but no single child scope independently explains the consequence apart from the shared cancellation chain.
The implementation briefs named the required files and behavior areas; the affected children were cancelled while probing or debugging, not blocked by an omitted known requirement.
The module split used distinct files and named exports, and no incompatible completed components were joined; the missing files resulted from cancellation before completion.
No known finding is shown disappearing between actors and causing repeated work; incomplete delivery is explained by cancelled active children.
Probe and child returns were long, but there is no parent decision point where available information was too bulky to consume and caused the final artifact gap.
No actor consumed superseded workspace or requirement state before acting; the unfinished state came from interrupted implementation children.
No incompatible child reports or contracts reached the parent and remained unadjudicated; unfinished modules had no completed handoff to conflict with.
The parent did not present the whole task as complete or accept a final solution; the run timed out and artifact validation found the missing entry afterward.
There was no replacement child or retry episode that repeated prior work without inherited checkpoints; the relevant workers were simply cancelled.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: The parallel parent launched an implementation swarm with active child work, then the orchestration was explicitly cancelled. The swarm result reported three aborted children, including unfinished extras and blocks work, and artifact validation later showed only partial library files with no test13.mjs entry.
candidates.realized_consequence: Three implementation children were aborted before needed modules and final assembly were finalized, leaving only partial library files and no test13.mjs deliverable.
candidates.near_match_reason: No Failure Takeover is downstream of the same cancellation chain; the directly observed boundary is the explicit active-child termination before results were finalized.

candidates.reason: No complete, directly promotable candidate or mutually compatible complete component set existed; extras and blocks were unfinished and interrupted by cancellation.
There was no integrated verification followed by a later merge; the parent never reached a whole-solution validation loop.
Some modules were completed, but the decisive missing work was not a retrievable completed implementation left unjoined; key delegated modules were cancelled before completion.
No verifier child produced a concrete finding trapped below the parent; implementation children were cancelled and completed module summaries did return.
The parent did not take over cancelled work, but that is downstream of the same explicit active-child cancellation episode already retained as Early Child Termination.
Completed child results for text, code, toc, and CLI were visible in the swarm result and partly present as files; no completed result was ignored in favor of an inconsistent decision.
The parent was interrupted during a live implementation swarm, but there is no separate blind waiting episode with available progress that the parent failed to inspect.
Concurrent children wrote or planned distinct module files; no overlapping behavior ownership produced competing completed designs requiring reconciliation.
No two live children edited the same source file or observed another actor changing the same file.
No child replaced or recreated a non-entry source file produced or owned by another child.
The required entry file test13.mjs was never created, so there was no overwrite of the deliverable.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple final workspace outputs or invalidated provenance.
Children shared /output, but the concrete problem was missing and cancelled work, not an unstable state or provenance problem from shared writes.
No generated cache, fixture, temporary path, tool, or auxiliary artifact from one actor was consumed by another as stable reference input.
